question_en: List the agreements flagging items for comeback (deferred-decision tracking).
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'comeback' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WHERE toLower(a.content) =~ '(?s).*\\bcome\\s*back\\b.*'
WITH DISTINCT a,m
ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.sequence ASC
LIMIT 10
RETURN a.resolutionId AS resolutionId

required_fields.name: resolutionId
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: a.resolutionId; distinct original Agreement record identity

query_change: Match case-insensitive whole-word comeback / come back; preserve original CQ2 default selection keys and limit; return the requested Agreement identity only.
source_context_interpretation: Recorded own-Agreement explicit return flags, including conditional reopeners as conditional records. The original content/comeback mapping supports this interpretation. No claim that every flagged technical choice is presently undecided, that a condition occurred, or that a later approval happened.
population_contract: The unchanged original RAN2 graph context:3413 Agreement records, not an expanded reconstruction of all physical meeting outcomes. All272 records at or above integer129 have one source-coordinate candidate; the ten effective records have directly inspected source bodies and roles.
source_default_extent_authority: Original design CQ2 default10 and the same-Spec validation/category binding; not LIMIT10 alone or an English-only top/recent phrase.
scored_order: Unordered Agreement identity set. The exact English requests a list, not ranked or chronological output. Default selection is retained; its serialization is not an extra required answer role under fixed ordering-and-ties-when-requested criteria.
cutoff_tie_policy: All ties relevant to selection are explicitly measured. The last group has one candidate and one slot; no ID tiebreaker. All ten effective flags are within the full272 dependency and all older records have lower integer meeting, so any within-meeting sequence assignment yields the same ten identities.
source_sequence_defect_preserved: Six of ten old-vs-current sequence fields differ. No current source sequence correctness is asserted and no sequence/agenda/rank claim is scored.
opposing_interpretation: The parenthetical deferred-decision tracking may be read as only currently unsettled decisions. Four latest records explicitly decide the technical choice and only reserve return if external issues/information arrives. That narrower reading yields a different eligible pool and cannot be silently substituted. The proposed reading prioritizes exact flagging wording plus original content-pattern authority and records the conditionality rather than asserting present open status.
